capsules.headline_hi: Dilli mein Diwali ke baad hawa sabse zehreeli

capsules.detail_hi: Diwali ke baad Dilli ki hawa paanch saal mein sabse kharab rahi, AQI 376; pandrah stationon par 'severe' darj hua.

capsules.headline_hi: Punjab mein ek din mein 1,152 parali aag
capsules.headline_hinglish: Punjab mein ek din mein 1,152 parali aag

capsules.headline_hi: Anuj Shrivatri Bharat ke 100ve Grandmaster bane
capsules.headline_hinglish: Anuj Shrivatri Bharat ke 100ve Grandmaster bane

capsules.headline_hi: Bharat ki arthvyavastha 7.4% badhegi, NSO anumaan
capsules.headline_hinglish: Bharat ki arthvyavastha 7.4% badhegi, NSO anumaan
capsules.detail_hi: NSO ke pehle agrim anumaan ke mutabik is vitt varsh mein Bharat ki GDP saat dashamlav chaar pratishat badhegi.
